card.name: Spanish spray storage instructions
card.fires_on: Words inside one Spanish spray label warning about the broken safety seal and storing away from heat, light and humidity. It fires on pieces of 'almacenar', 'medicamento', and the words just before 'a no más de 30°C'.

modes.label: Spanish storage line
modes.description: Words in the Spanish storage sentence about protecting the medicine from heat, light and humidity.
modes.example: Mantener el medicamento protegido del calor, luz y humedad, almacen<<ar>> a no más de 30°C

modes.label: Seal warning
modes.description: Words in the Spanish warning not to use the spray if the safety seal is broken.
modes.example: No utilizar si<< el>> sello de seguridad del spray esta ro
